newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenia atomic plant to shut for 50 days repairs.
newsitem.headline: Armenia atomic plant to shut for 50 days repairs.

text.p: Armenia's Metsamor nuclear power plant will close for annual refuelling and repairs in mid-July, the plant's chief engineer said on Wednesday.

"We will try to keep working until July 20," Gagik Markosyan told Reuters. He said the plant had originally been scheduled to work until August, but that present fuel in its one working block was already close to exhaustion.
He said the stoppage was likely to last 50 days.
"Scheduled maintainance is always needed to ensure the safety of the plant" he said.

Metsamor was closed between 1989 and 1995 after a massive earthquake killed over 25,000 people in the landlocked former Soviet republic. It was recommissioned in part to relieve a grave energy shortage.
Metsamor at present supplies around a third of supplies to the 3.5 million population.
Energy Ministry officials said they did not expect any disruptions in supplies to consumers or commercial clients.
